input: n is an integer with 0 <= n <= 9. Integers are plain int values, excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists rather than subclasses; strings are ordinary str values. Standard built-ins are unmodified and no concurrent mutation occurs. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Declared size bounds do not guarantee allocation capacity or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: The exact integer number of distinct placements of n nonattacking queens on an n-by-n board, one per row and column, counting symmetry-related boards separately. n = 0 returns 1 for the empty placement. No board strings are constructed or returned.
mutation_aliasing: There is no mutable input. The three occupancy arrays are private to the call and restored after each recursive choice. The Solution instance retains no state; repeated calls are independent.
numeric: For n <= 9, all occupancy indices fit their arrays. Every nonnegative recursive count and partial sum is bounded by n! <= 362880; exact safe-integer arithmetic is maintained throughout. Maximum helper depth is n + 1 <= 10.
complexity: O(n*n! + 1) worst-case time and O(n + 1) auxiliary occupancy/stack space. Each partial nonrepeating-column placement scans n columns, and the number of such partial placements is bounded by a constant times n!. Only a scalar count is returned; there is no hidden board materialization or symmetry shortcut.

helpers.name: count_from
helpers.contract: A row-by-row recursive closure with the same column and diagonal occupancy rules as solveNQueens. Return one at a complete placement; otherwise sum counts of valid choices while restoring all three occupancy arrays after each recursive call.
